rationale: C1, C2 (GO setting up the Green Climate Company for three missions), C3 and C5 concern forest and wetland restoration generally; none appoints 75,000 youngsters or reserves seats for women. Related activity only, no step for this commitment.

cited.quote: Crop Insurance scheme is being implemented in Tamil Nadu with a view to protect farmers from crop losses

rationale: C1, C2, C3 and C5 show the existing crop insurance scheme continuing (premium subsidies, 2021-22 implementation); C4 is wildlife damage compensation. No new measure ensuring compensation when even a single farmer's land is affected. Same activity carrying on.
